# RestrictedWeapons — Plugify C++ port of the Pisex plugin "RestrictedWeapons":
# weapon count restrictions per player-count threshold, enforced in a polyhook detour of
# CCSPlayer_ItemServices::CanAcquire, plus the IRWApi (OnWeaponRestricted) the
# restricted_weapons_vip module registers with.
#
#   rw_core                   engine-free core (config model, threshold/decision rules) - also
#                             used by tests
#   rw_bindings               binding globals (__RestrictedWeapons_*) generated by bin/plugify-gen
#                             from RestrictedWeapons.pplugin; consumers (restricted_weapons_vip)
#                             compile it into their own .so, the plugin itself only uses the
#                             callback typedef from the generated header
#   plugify-RestrictedWeapons the plugin shared library (entry "bin/RestrictedWeapons")

set(RESTRICTED_WEAPONS_VERSION "1.0.1")

# --- generated consumer bindings ----------------------------------------------
# The .pplugin for the generator needs the version substituted at configure time.
set(RW_PPLUGIN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/RestrictedWeapons.pplugin")
configure_file(
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/RestrictedWeapons.pplugin.in"
        "${RW_PPLUGIN}"
)

# plugify-gen writes <output>/external/plugify/include/<name>/..., the same layout the hudmenu
# and admin_system plugins use; include/external/plugify/include is therefore the include root of
# the generated consumer API and include/rw_api.hpp (hand written) sits next to it.
set(RW_INCLUDE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/external/plugify/include")
set(RW_BINDINGS_CPP "${RW_INCLUDE_ROOT}/RestrictedWeapons/RestrictedWeapons.cpp")

# Refreshes the bindings with the current manifest. Best effort by design: the generated headers
# are checked in and are the source of truth for compilation, so a host without the generator
# keeps building (the checked-in files stay untouched).
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin/plugify-gen")
    add_custom_command(
            OUTPUT "${RW_BINDINGS_CPP}"
            COMMAND sh -c "'${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin/plugify-gen' -manifest '${RW_PPLUGIN}' -output '${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include' -lang cpp -overwrite || { echo 'plugify-gen failed (ignored, keeping the checked-in bindings)'; touch '${RW_BINDINGS_CPP}'; }"
            DEPENDS "${RW_PPLUGIN}"
            COMMENT "plugify-gen: RestrictedWeapons bindings"
            VERBATIM
    )
    add_custom_target(rw_bindings_gen ALL
            DEPENDS "${RW_BINDINGS_CPP}")
else()
    add_custom_target(rw_bindings_gen ALL
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "bin/plugify-gen not found: keeping the checked-in RestrictedWeapons bindings")
endif()

# The generated binding globals are third-party code: no -Werror on them. Consumers of the API
# (plugins/restricted_weapons_vip, plugins/RestrictedWeapons/tests) link this object library.
set(RW_BINDINGS_OBJECTS "")
if(EXISTS "${RW_BINDINGS_CPP}")
    add_library(rw_bindings OBJECT "${RW_BINDINGS_CPP}")
    target_include_directories(rw_bindings SYSTEM PUBLIC "${RW_INCLUDE_ROOT}")
    target_include_directories(rw_bindings SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include")
    target_compile_definitions(rw_bindings PUBLIC _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1)
    add_dependencies(rw_bindings rw_bindings_gen)
    set(RW_BINDINGS_OBJECTS "$<TARGET_OBJECTS:rw_bindings>")
endif()

# --- core ---------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(rw_core STATIC src/rw_core.cpp)
target_include_directories(rw_core PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
# pisexcompat brings the KV1 parser (for Pisex-style configs) and, PUBLIC, the s2sdk/hudmenu globals.
target_link_libraries(rw_core PUBLIC pisexcompat)
target_include_directories(rw_core SYSTEM PRIVATE
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/pisexcompat/include")
target_compile_options(rw_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wshadow -Werror)
target_compile_definitions(rw_core PUBLIC _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1)

# --- plugin -------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(plugify-RestrictedWeapons SHARED
        src/plugin.cpp
        $<TARGET_OBJECTS:s2sdk_bindings>
        $<TARGET_OBJECTS:polyhook_bindings>
)
target_include_directories(plugify-RestrictedWeapons PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
# SYSTEM: warnings from the generated s2sdk/polyhook/plg/pisexcompat headers must not fail -Werror
# on our sources.
target_include_directories(plugify-RestrictedWeapons SYSTEM PRIVATE
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/pisexcompat/include"
        # The generated consumer headers of our own plugin: only the WeaponRestrictedCallback
        # typedef is used (the binding slots stay null in the producer).
        "${RW_INCLUDE_ROOT}")
target_link_libraries(plugify-RestrictedWeapons PRIVATE
        rw_core
        pisexcompat
        -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc
)
target_compile_options(plugify-RestrictedWeapons PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_compile_definitions(plugify-RestrictedWeapons PRIVATE
        _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1
        PLUGIFY_MODULE="RestrictedWeapons"
        PLUGIFY_IS_DEBUG=0
        PLUGIFY_IS_RELEASE=1
)
set_target_properties(plugify-RestrictedWeapons PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME RestrictedWeapons)

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    target_link_options(plugify-RestrictedWeapons PRIVATE
            "-Wl,--version-script,${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sym/version_script.lds")
endif()

# --- tests --------------------------------------------------------------------
# rw_core_tests: config parsing + decision rules of the engine-free core, against a real config.
add_executable(rw_core_tests tests/rw_core_tests.cpp)
target_include_directories(rw_core_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include")
target_link_libraries(rw_core_tests PRIVATE rw_core -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc)
target_compile_options(rw_core_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_compile_definitions(rw_core_tests PRIVATE
        _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1
        RW_TEST_CONFIG="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/data/restricted_weapons.ini")
set_target_properties(rw_core_tests PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests")

# rw_api_tests: the consumer wrapper (include/rw_api.hpp) with stubbed binding slots.
if(RW_BINDINGS_OBJECTS)
    add_executable(rw_api_tests tests/rw_api_tests.cpp ${RW_BINDINGS_OBJECTS})
    target_include_directories(rw_api_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
            "${RW_INCLUDE_ROOT}"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include")
    target_link_libraries(rw_api_tests PRIVATE -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc)
    target_compile_options(rw_api_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
    target_compile_definitions(rw_api_tests PRIVATE _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1)
    set_target_properties(rw_api_tests PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests")
endif()
